applies_to: Public & private data controllers and processors
key_requirements: Controller registration, data protection principles, data subject rights
retention_period: s.24: not retained longer than necessary for purpose unless required by law, lawful function, contract or consent; research/statistics exceptions
penalties_range: Up to 5,000 penalty units and/or 10 years' imprisonment
deceased_data: Not covered: Data Protection Commission describes its mandate as protecting the privacy of living individuals; no post-mortem rule found (unconfirmed)
research_exemption: Research exemption exists among the exemptions in ss. 60-74 (research, history and statistics) subject to safeguards; exact section not confirmed
genetic_data: Special personal data (ss. 37-45) includes physical, medical or mental health and DNA of the data subject; processing prohibited unless an exception applies
notes: Registration certificate valid 2 years; a 2025 replacement bill is still only a draft
